pregame.pressurePoint: Browns pass game vs Jets pass defense. The Jets are No. 1 of 32 at limiting explosive passes (1.01) and No. 28 in pass success allowed (50%). The Browns rank No. 23 in pass explosiveness (1.26) and No. 11 in pass success rate (49%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Deep balls are the lowest-percentage play in this game. The Browns need the underneath game and yards after catch. Watch the longest Browns completion. If it is under 25 yards at the half, the Jets have won the matchup.
